topic: New Agent install sends nothing, API key invalid
environment: Org hosted on a non-default Datadog site
symptom_pattern: A freshly installed Agent never appears in the Infrastructure list. Logs repeat 'API Key invalid, dropping transaction' even though the key was just copied from the org.
root_cause: The org lives on a different Datadog site than the Agent submits to (DD_SITE missing or wrong), so the key is validated against the wrong region and rejected.
resolution_path: Check the forwarder/API key section of agent status
Confirm which site the org is on (URL in the browser)
Set DD_SITE to the org's site and restart
info_needed: the URL they use to log in to Datadog

qa_pairs.tse_question: What URL do you use to log into Datadog?
Can you paste the Forwarder section of agent status?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: It says API key ending with 3f9a2: API Key invalid.

customer_style.tone: new to Datadog, eager, low context
